description_sq:
Ofrohet apartament 2+1 +2 per shitje tek kopshti Zoologjik, tek Rezidenca Salillari. 
Apartamenti ka nje planimteri te rregullt, me siperfaqe totale 129.64 m2, siperfaqe apartamenti 110.61 m2. 
Aartamenti organizohet ne sallon se bashku me kuzhinen, dhome gjumi matrimoniale me tualet ,nje dhome gjumi ,nje tualet dhe nje ballkon me nje horizont te gjelberuar. 
Rezdienca Slillari eshte nje kompleks i ri i cili ofron: 
-Cilesi ndertimi 
-Fasada te ventiluara me termoizolim 5cm, me veshje te jashtme guri travertine ose te ngjashme 
-Dyshemete do te shtrohen me parket 
-Dritaret do te jene termike me nje dhome ajri me gas, me dy xhama, termik dhe tripleks 
-Hidrosanitaret inkaso/sospeso 
-Elektriket do te jene ABB. 
-Posedon edhe nje parkim me cmim ekstra 35.000 euro 
Objekti ka 3 blloqe me shkalle te perbera secila nga 2 ashensore. Ka 6 kate mbi toke secila kulle, ku katet perdhe jane dyqane zyra dhe katet larte banim. Ka 1 katet nentoke ne front, dhe 4 kate nentoke ne fund.
description_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale at the Zoo, Salillari Residence. The apartment has a regular layout, with a total area of ​​129.64 m2, apartment area 110.61 m2. The apartment is organized in the living room together with the kitchen, a matrimonial bedroom with a toilet, a bedroom, a toilet and a balcony with a green horizon. Rezdienca Slillari is a new complex that offers: - Quality of construction - Ventilated facades with 5 cm thermal insulation, with external travertine stone cladding or similar - The floors will be laid with parquet - The windows will be thermal with a gas air chamber, double-glazed, thermal and triplex - Incaso/sospeso sanitary ware - Electricity will be ABB. -It also has a parking lot with an extra price of 35,000 euros. The building has 3 blocks of stairs, each with 2 elevators. Each tower has 6 floors above ground, where the ground floors are shops, offices and the upper floors are residential. There is 1 underground floor at the front, and 4 underground floors at the end.
